title: Normalized ordinary open total tensor and coefficient comparisons
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site, $R$ a commutative ring sheaf, and $V\in\mathcal C$, with module sheafification and its locally-bijective compatibility on the site and slice in a universe containing the object and Hom universes. Use the genuine complexes, scalar extension, slice restriction, extension by zero and three comparison shapes of [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-data]. There exist comparisons $e=(\gamma,r,\rho)$ for all coefficient algebras and all possibly unbounded cochain complexes, satisfying the three normalizations of [def-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-normalization]: $\gamma([x]_f\otimes y)=[x\otimes y|_V]_f$, $r(a\otimes[x]_f)=[a|_V\otimes x]_f$, their reverse inverse formulas, and $\rho(a\otimes y|_V)=(a\otimes y)|_V$. These are isomorphisms in the actual coefficient-linear complex categories, with signed direct-sum total tensor. No interchange or coefficient-transition assertion is included.

proof.text: Totalize the normalized module projection isomorphism $\psi$ over every commutative coefficient ring $B$. Extension is a left adjoint, so it preserves the coproduct over all pairs $p+q=n$. Naturality of $\psi$ in each differential gives the chain equation; additivity preserves the sign $(-1)^p$, also for negative $p$. The inverse is totalized in the reverse direction. Apply the module generator formulas before each coproduct insertion to get the two gamma formulas.

proof.text: Apply its coefficient-linear natural isomorphism $r$ to every degree of a complex. Naturality in the differential makes this a chain isomorphism, with the module forward and reverse formulas unchanged.

source.place: Tags 0E8I (lemma-j-shriek-and-tensor), 03CY, 03EK and 03EL; agent cochain and coefficient refinement of the indicated steps of lem-sf-open-total-tensor-coefficient-interchange.

proof.text: Restriction along the slice forgetful functor evaluates each section and coefficient at the same object. Thus scalar extension and slice restriction have identical sectionwise balanced tensors. Their sheafification universal properties give the comparison $\rho$. Its forward formula is identity on these tensor generators. Collect the three comparisons and the normalizations; no equation between their composites is used.
